final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.track_count, CASE WHEN a.avg_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE c.track_count / a.avg_count END AS ratio FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN average_count AS a ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, c.PlaylistId LIMIT 10
